results.message: Running as root is not allowed. Every container (spec.containers[*], spec.initContainers[*], and spec.ephemeralContainers[*]) must set securityContext.runAsNonRoot to `true`, or inherit `true` from spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot. Neither spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot nor container-level securityContext.runAsNonRoot may be set to `false`. Setting spec.hostUsers to `false` does not exempt a Pod. Windows Pods are exempt.
Privilege escalation is disallowed.  All containers must set the securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation field to `false`. Windows Pods are exempt.

Use of custom Seccomp profiles is disallowed. The fields spec.containers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type, spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type, and spec.ephemeralContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type must be set to `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`, or inherited from spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type. Windows Pods are exempt.
Containers must drop `ALL` capabilities. Windows Pods are exempt.

annotations.policies.kyverno.io/description: Adding capabilities other than `NET_BIND_SERVICE` is disallowed. In addition, all containers must explicitly drop `ALL` capabilities.

validations.message: Containers must drop `ALL` capabilities. Windows Pods are exempt.

validations.expression:
variables.isWindowsPod || variables.allContainers.all(container,
  container.image in exceptions.allowedImages ||
  container.?securityContext.?capabilities.?add.orValue([]).all(capability,
    capability == 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' || capability in exceptions.allowedValues))
validations.message: Any capabilities added other than NET_BIND_SERVICE are disallowed. Windows Pods are exempt.

annotations.policies.kyverno.io/description: Privilege escalation, such as via set-user-ID or set-group-ID file mode, should not be allowed. This policy ensures the `allowPrivilegeEscalation` field is set to `false`.

validations.expression:
variables.isWindowsPod || variables.allContainers.all(container,
  container.image in exceptions.allowedImages ||
  container.?securityContext.?allowPrivilegeEscalation.orValue(true) == false)
validations.message: Privilege escalation is disallowed.  All containers must set the securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation field to `false`. Windows Pods are exempt.

annotations.policies.kyverno.io/description: Containers must run as non-root users. This policy ensures that every container sets `runAsNonRoot` to `true` or inherits it from the Pod, and that neither sets it to `false`. Missing or null init and ephemeral container lists are treated as empty. Konstapel variant: `spec.hostUsers: false` is not an exemption (a workload that cannot run as non-root needs a recorded exception), and explicit Windows Pods are outside scope.

validations.expression:
variables.isWindowsPod || (variables.podSpec.?securityContext.?runAsNonRoot.orValue(true) == true &&
  variables.ctnrs.all(c,
    c.image in exceptions.allowedImages ||
    c.?securityContext.?runAsNonRoot.orValue(
      variables.podSpec.?securityContext.?runAsNonRoot.orValue(false)) == true))
validations.message: Running as root is not allowed. Every container (spec.containers[*], spec.initContainers[*], and spec.ephemeralContainers[*]) must set securityContext.runAsNonRoot to `true`, or inherit `true` from spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot. Neither spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot nor container-level securityContext.runAsNonRoot may be set to `false`. Setting spec.hostUsers to `false` does not exempt a Pod. Windows Pods are exempt.

annotations.policies.kyverno.io/description: The Restricted profile requires a seccomp profile of `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`. The Pod-level seccomp profile must be unset or set to one of these values. Each container must set one of these values or inherit a valid Pod-level profile, so a Pod with no valid profile at either level is denied. Windows Pods are exempt.

validations.message: Use of custom Seccomp profiles is disallowed. The field spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type must be unset or set to `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`. Windows Pods are exempt.

validations.expression:
variables.isWindowsPod || variables.allContainers.all(container,
  container.?securityContext.?seccompProfile.?type.orValue('') in ['RuntimeDefault', 'Localhost'] ||
  (container.?securityContext.?seccompProfile.?type.hasValue() &&
   (container.image in exceptions.allowedImages ||
    ('seccomp.type:' + container.securityContext.seccompProfile.type) in exceptions.allowedValues)) ||
  (!container.?securityContext.?seccompProfile.?type.hasValue() &&
   (variables.podSpec.?securityContext.?seccompProfile.?type.orValue('') in ['RuntimeDefault', 'Localhost'] ||
    ('seccomp.type:' + variables.podSpec.?securityContext.?seccompProfile.?type.orValue('')) in exceptions.allowedValues)))
validations.message: Use of custom Seccomp profiles is disallowed. The fields spec.containers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type, spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type, and spec.ephemeralContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type must be set to `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`, or inherited from spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type. Windows Pods are exempt.
